name: LIAO Basic – Analizador IAO
author: flipaz

sections.description:
What is LIAO Basic?

LIAO Basic – Analizador IAO is a pioneering plugin designed to analyze content using the IAO Method:

👉 SEO + UX + AI Optimization.

IAO (Artificial Intelligence and Optimization) is the complete method. It integrates SEO, UX and AI Optimization as complementary layers. AIO / AI Optimization is one integrated layer of the method, not an interchangeable name for IAO.

Its goal is not only to improve rankings, but also to help create content that is:

  • clearer
  • more useful
  • easier to understand
  • more reusable by artificial intelligence systems

What does it analyze?

The plugin evaluates content using three main blocks:

🔎 Found (SEO)

Analyzes whether your content can be properly found and interpreted by Google and other search engines.

💡 Understood (UX)

Analyzes clarity, structure and readability for real users.

Recommended (AI Optimization)

Analyzes whether the content is properly structured for AI systems such as ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude or Perplexity. This is the AI Optimization layer within the IAO Method.

Plugin Philosophy

LIAO is not designed to generate artificial scores.

👉 Its goal is to help explain knowledge more effectively.

The plugin does not reward:

  • over-optimization
  • excessive repetition
  • forced structures

Instead, it prioritizes:

  • clarity
  • coherence
  • real usefulness
  • understandable structure

How is it different from traditional SEO plugins?

Many plugins focus primarily on keywords and technical metrics.

LIAO adds an additional layer:

👉 clarity 👉 understandable structure 👉 real usefulness 👉 AI optimization

The goal is not only to rank.

👉 The goal is to explain knowledge better.

Note About Scores

LIAO scores are intended as guidance.

The purpose of the plugin is to help identify opportunities for improvement from three perspectives inside the IAO Method: SEO (Found), UX (Understood) and AI Optimization (Recommended).

Not every page needs to achieve a perfect 100/100 score.

For example:

  • A contact page has different requirements than a complete guide or blog article.
  • A commercial page may prioritize conversions over content depth.
  • Some criteria may be more or less relevant depending on the type of content.

Use the recommendations as guidance, not as an obligation.

The ultimate goal is not to achieve a perfect score, but to create content that is clearer, more useful and easier to understand for people, search engines and AI systems.

Final Message

LIAO is not designed to help you write more.

👉 It is designed to help you explain better.

IAO Method – flipaz.es – 2026
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to WordPress.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Open a page or post.
  4. Fill in the snippet with your main topic, meta title and meta description.
  5. Save the content and click “Analyze”.
  6. Review the IAO recommendations.
  7. Save your changes and run the analysis again to see the updated score.
sections.faq:
What is IAO?

IAO stands for:

👉 Artificial Intelligence and Optimization.

It is a methodology that combines:

  • SEO
  • UX
  • AI Optimization as an integrated layer

Do I need SEO knowledge?

No.

LIAO is designed for real people and provides clear, easy-to-understand recommendations. Freelancers, small businesses and content creators can use it without technical expertise.

Does it work with any WordPress theme?

Yes.

The plugin is designed to work with any modern WordPress theme.

Does it replace RankMath or Yoast?

Not necessarily.

LIAO is not intended to be another traditional SEO plugin.

👉 Its focus is on clarity, knowledge and AI optimization.

What exactly does it analyze?

Among other aspects:

  • content structure
  • topical clarity
  • knowledge blocks
  • coherence
  • readability
  • semantic structure
  • IAO optimization

Does the plugin automatically write content?

No.

LIAO Basic is designed to analyze and guide.

What does the “Recommended” section mean?

The “Recommended” block evaluates whether content is structured in a way that can be understood and reused by AI systems such as ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude and Perplexity.

Does it only work for blog posts?

No.

LIAO Basic can be used on both pages and posts and can help optimize different types of content within WordPress:

  • Homepage
  • Internal pages
  • Service and product descriptions
  • Blog posts
  • Ecommerce content
  • Corporate content
